create_a11y_servicer: create an A11yServicer instance to handle Android accessibility gRPC requests with optional latest_forest_only mode
review_bidi_stream: review the A11yServicer Bidi method that processes bidirectional gRPC streams for events and accessibility forests
gather_forests: gather and clear the buffered Android accessibility forests from the A11yServicer instance
gather_events: gather and clear the buffered accessibility events from the A11yServicer instance
pause_and_resume: pause the A11yServicer to stop receiving events and forests then resume after environment reset
